lines.text: The sea rose, and it never went back. The cities are under your keel now. What's left of us lives on what floats.
I'm Wren. I draw the charts here in Driftholm. Take the radio, Captain. I'll be in your ear until you stop needing me.
Thumb on the wheel, and drag it toward where you want to go. She'll come round. The gold arrow points at your next job.
That tower was offices, once. Slow down beside the buoy, and tap Salvage.
Watch the needle. Reel in when it crosses the green. Catch the gold centre, and the sea gives a little extra.
Good. Now, nothing you haul is yours until it's on the dock. Come home and tie up.
Sell what you don't need to Pip. Then see Marlo. Every part he fits, you'll see it on the boat.
Now, the errand. A bottle washed up on Turtle Atoll, to the west. Follow the gold arrow. Don't read what's inside.
Shallow water. Let go of the wheel, drop the anchor, and go ashore.
Same thumb, same wheel. It moves your feet now. Walk the beach, and look for the glint.
You read it. Good. The landmarks on that map are real. Stand where it says, and dig.
Bring it home, Captain. And watch the sky. Squalls come up fast out here.
That's your first voyage done. From here, the Captain's Log tells you what's next. Salvage. Refit. Push further out.
Feel her slow down? You're pointing into the wind. Turn away a little, and the sail fills again.
Your hold is full. Take it home and bank it, before the sea takes it back.
She's taking water. Patch her from the Ship screen, or limp home to Marlo.
An engine. Tap the engine button to run it. It's fast, and it's thirsty.
Fuel's low. Sail when the wind lets you. Save the engine for when it won't.
Dark comes quick out here. Your lookout dial still shows the way home.
Storm cell. Go round it if you can. If you can't, hold on, and mind your hull.
Rustfang. They ride wave runners, and they take what they like. Outrun them under engine, or fit a harpoon and teach them manners.
The Sunken Reach. A whole city under you. Richer salvage out here, and worse company.
The Stormwall. Nobody I know has come back from it. Be the first.
Crew aren't passengers. Each one does a job you'd only do badly. Find more of them.
Is that green? Keep it alive, Captain. That is the rarest thing left in the world.
Three hulls. She'll take the open swell now. Rig Helios is west, past the edge of my chart.
Still floating, Captain. Good. Your log has the next job.
Rustfang runners! Coming in hard!
